description: Beautifully remodeled 2 bedroom, 1 bath end unit offering single level living in the desirable Paradise Hills area. VA and FHA approved, making this an excellent opportunity for first time homebuyers, military buyers, and downsizers. This move in ready home features an open concept living and dining area that flows seamlessly to a private patio, creating the perfect indoor outdoor lifestyle. The updated kitchen includes new appliances, ample cabinetry, and pantry storage. Enjoy the convenience of an interior laundry area, central air conditioning, and quality finishes throughout. Enjoy two private patios. The main patio offers a comfortable outdoor entertaining space, while the second private patio is accessible directly from the primary bedroom, providing a peaceful retreat. As an end unit, the home offers added privacy in a quiet, well maintained community. Ideally situated approximately 15 minutes from Downtown San Diego, with easy access to Highway 54, Interstate 5, and Interstate 805, making commuting throughout San Diego County simple.

Enjoy Gorgeous ocean view sunsets from this stunning two-story coastal retreat in the heart of Del Mar. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this beautiful home is ideally located near the Del Mar Village, world-renowned beaches, Torrey Pines Reserve, premier shopping and dining, and top-rated schools. The light-filled living room showcases spectacular ocean views and opens to an expansive deck, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor living experience. The gourmet kitchen and dining area also enjoy sweeping blue-water views and feature chef-quality appliances, a large center island, and elegant finishes. Rich wood flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by sophisticated stone and tile accents. Experience the best of Southern California coastal living and make the Del Mar dream your reality.
description_es: Disfrute de impresionantes puestas de sol frente al mar desde este magnífico refugio costero de dos plantas en el corazón de Del Mar. Con 3 recámaras y 3.5 baños, esta hermosa casa está idealmente ubicada cerca del Del Mar Village, playas de renombre mundial, la Reserva de Torrey Pines, centros comerciales y restaurantes de primer nivel, y escuelas de alta calificación. La sala iluminada exhibe espectaculares vistas al océano y se abre a una amplia terraza, creando la experiencia perfecta de vida interior-exterior. La cocina gourmet y el área de comedor también disfrutan de vistas panorámicas al mar, con electrodomésticos de nivel chef, una gran isla central y acabados elegantes. Pisos de madera rica fluyen por toda la casa, complementados por sofisticados detalles de piedra y azulejo. Viva lo mejor de la vida costera del sur de California y haga realidad el sueño de Del Mar.

description: Perched in prestigious Del Mar Heights, this Masterfully reconstructed 5 bed, 5 bath residence of approximately 4,300 sq ft embodies elevated coastal luxury for the most discerning buyer. Every aspect has been thoughtfully renewed throughout this entire home renovation, from new windows, New plumbing, and electrical to smooth interior/exterior paint and European white oak wood flooring that sets a warm, sophisticated tone. The sculptural chef’s kitchen is anchored by Taj Mahal stone counters, massive island, white limestone wrapped pillars and feature wall, custom millwork, custom hood encompassed by Venetian plaster and a suite of Wolf and Zline appliances, flowing effortlessly into refined living and dining spaces oriented to capture tranquil ocean views. Designed for both intimate living and grand entertaining, the home offers a multimedia lounge, private gym, dry sauna, and a climate-controlled wine room. Walls of glass open to a resort-style backyard with a brand new pool, spa, porcelain pavers, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor experience. With designer finishes throughout and a flexible lower level designed for complete formal ADU, this is a rare opportunity to own a truly bespoke Del Mar estate. A true work of art!
description_es: Enclavada en las prestigiosas Del Mar Heights, esta magistralmente reconstruida residencia de 5 recámaras y 5 baños de aproximadamente 4,300 pies cuadrados encarna el lujo costero elevado. La escultural cocina de chef está anclada por encimeras de piedra Taj Mahal, una enorme isla central, columnas revestidas de piedra caliza blanca, carpintería personalizada, campana con yeso veneciano y electrodomésticos Wolf y Zline, fluyendo hacia refinadas áreas de sala y comedor con tranquilas vistas al océano. Diseñada para la vida íntima y el entretenimiento de gran escala, la casa ofrece sala multimedia, gimnasio privado, sauna seco y bodega con control climático. Paredes de vidrio se abren a un jardín resort con nueva piscina, spa, pisos de porcelana y cocina exterior totalmente equipada, creando una experiencia indoor-outdoor perfecta. Con acabados de diseñador y un nivel inferior flexible para ADU formal, esta es una oportunidad única de poseer una verdadera obra de arte en Del Mar.

description: Prime location. Welcome to this newly reimagined, single-level, model-perfect home offering a beautiful combination of charm, comfort, quality finishes, and an exceptional central San Diego lifestyle.  Thoughtfully updated throughout, this inviting residence features luxury laminated wood flooring, crown molding, recessed lighting, custom cabinetry, and large windows that fill the home with natural light while capturing views of the beautifully landscaped front yard. The spacious living room is warm and welcoming, highlighted by a fabulous fireplace that creates an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining.  The modern kitchen has been tastefully designed with sleek cabinetry, a convenient built-in spice rack, stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and a charming bay window that brings in additional light and character.  The large backyard offers a wonderful extension of the living space, with plenty of grassy area, lush landscaping, and mature fruit trees. Whether enjoying morning coffee, gardening, entertaining friends, or simply relaxing outdoors, the yard provides a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.  Additional features include a spacious basement, ideal for a workshop, storage, hobby area, or creative workspace, along with a covered one-car parking space in the garage. Beyond the home itself, the location is a major highlight. Situated in the desirable 92103 area of San Diego, 912 Bush Street offers convenient access to some of the city’s most beloved neighborhoods and attractions. Enjoy close proximity to Mission Hills, Hillcrest, Old Town, Downtown San Diego, Balboa Park, Little Italy, the waterfront, and San Diego International Airport. This central location offers the best of both worlds: a comfortable residential setting with easy access to restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, parks, cultural attractions, and the vibrant energy of urban San Diego. From weekend dining in Mission Hills or Hillcrest, to walks through Balboa Park, evenings in Little Italy, or quick access to downtown and the bay, this home places you near the heart of everything San Diego has to offer.  Beautifully updated, move-in ready, and ideally located, 912 Bush Street presents a rare opportunity to enjoy single-level living, generous outdoor space, and an exceptional lifestyle in one of San Diego’s most convenient and connected areas.
